headline: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels launches Zone Connect in Visakhapatnam
hook: New Vizag property expands portfolio footprint
summary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited has announced the official launch of a new hotel, Zone Connect by The Park, in Visakhapatnam. The press release details the expansion of the company's hospitality offerings into the coastal city. Such property additions incrementally build the brand's operational footprint across regional markets. Indian retail investors tracking hospitality sector expansion can monitor how these openings contribute to overall revenues.
why_it_matters: Incremental property additions support long-term revenue growth for hospitality stocks.
